name: rust-crate-target
body: A local crate target of a Cargo package: the unit the Rust frontend loads for a library, binary, example, test, or bench target. Its graph identity is a module prefix rendered by the frontend; two distinct crate targets of the same package must carry distinct prefixes so their modules do not collide. In a default lib+bin package the library target and the binary target both take the package's name, so their display names are identical and the package name cannot disambiguate them.
